description: Makes a draft waiting on a dashboard (read_dashboard lists them) the version people see, saved as accepted by the assistant for the person. Only where the workspace owner lets assistants apply their dashboard changes; elsewhere the answer is not-allowed and the draft waits for a person to accept in Data Studio, so say so. Every version is kept, so undo_dashboard puts the one before back.

dashboard_id.description: The dashboard's id (list_dashboards gives them, dsh_...).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: accept_dashboard_draft
title: Accept a dashboard draft
